beats.text: Qatar has 108 micrograms of particles, the world's highest. Greenland has 2.
These suspended particles penetrate deep into the respiratory tract, causing severe health damage.
Saudi Arabia has 74, while USA has 7.
Nigeria has 66, across both urban and rural areas.
India has 54, far above the median country of 18.
Japan has 11. The UK has 9. Australia has 6.
